{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_vrtx_011ChDisaeqaSKgCDYWzsujm","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"I found eight separate bugs behind what goes wrong in the clip and fixed all of them. The project builds and the unit tests pass, except one network address test that fails because this machine has no internet. I couldn't run the game here to make a new recording, so none of these fixes have been checked by looking at the result.\n\n**Stairs, slabs and other shaped blocks** (`src/client/content_mapblock.cpp`, `src/mapnode.cpp`)\n- **Missing sides:** the code mixed up the +X and −X directions for these blocks. It gave the left and right sides each other's textures and judged the wrong neighbour when deciding whether a side is hidden. That's why faces were missing from some angles.\n- **Wrong facing:** facing values 1 and 3 turned the block's shape the opposite way from its textures and from mesh blocks. Stairs ended up facing the wrong way and their selection boxes didn't fit them.\n\n**Blocks that link to their neighbours** (`src/client/content_mapblock.cpp`)\n- **Rails:** two kinds of curve had their angles swapped, so corners pointed away from the track.\n- **Fences:** to decide whether to draw rails in the +Z direction, the code looked at the diagonal block (+X+Z) instead of the one directly in +Z. Fences only joined up along one axis.\n- **Framed glass:** two of the frame edges looked at the −X neighbour instead of +X. That left the stray vertical frame lines in the middle of the window.\n\n**Selection box on ladders and signs** (`src/mapnode.cpp`): for blocks fixed to a ±Z wall, the box was turned the wrong way, so it stuck out of the wall instead of sitting on the ladder or sign.\n\n**Things disappearing, close by and far away** (`src/client/tile.cpp`, `src/client/tile.h`, `src/nodedef.cpp`): the grass top is a second picture painted over dirt. To stop the two pictures flickering, the game told the depth test the second picture was nearer the camera than it really is. That hid anything sitting just above it: the selection box on grass showed only two broken edges, and rails on grass vanished from a distance.\n- **Fix:** the second picture now stays at its true depth. Instead, only the main picture underneath it is treated as slightly farther away, on blocks that have a second picture.
